description:
Moon phase at a moment: phase angle, common name (e.g. "Waxing Gibbous"),
illuminated fraction, the Moon's sign, and the next four quarter events
(new moon, first quarter, full moon, last quarter) with exact times.

Example:
  - "What's the moon phase tonight, and when is the next full moon?" -> {}
    (datetime defaults to now)

datetime.description: Moment to compute for. Defaults to now.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the datetime is local to, e.g. "Europe/Riga" or "America/New_York". Omit when the datetime already carries Z or a UTC offset.

name: get_moon_phase
title: Get Moon Phase
